scenes.say: I tested ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini on five real tasks. Here's which one I'd actually use for what.

scenes.sub: Claude or Gemini · both kept every fact
scenes.say: Writing an email? Claude or Gemini. Both kept every fact. Gemini even put it straight into Gmail.

scenes.sub: Gemini · every price matched · still click the link
scenes.say: Finding something to buy, with sources? Gemini. Every price matched. Still, click the link.

scenes.sub: Gemini found the most · check the numbers yourself
scenes.say: Analysing a spreadsheet? Gemini found the most, but none of them found everything. So check the numbers yourself.

scenes.sub: ChatGPT or Claude · cleaner code, no fake data
scenes.say: Building a quick app? ChatGPT or Claude. Cleaner code, and no fake data.

scenes.sub: Any of them · all three scored 10
scenes.say: Learning something new? Honestly, any of them. All three scored ten.
Final score: ChatGPT forty, Claude forty-one, Gemini forty-four.
